notes.title: Important changes - Pivot
notes.content:
So.... very long time no updates, not cuz we did nothing, but we were preparing a very big and important change.
Some of you might love it, and some might be a little concerned. The big news:

We have finished working on the game design document, pipelines for each aspect of development, so what are the changes we are talking about?

Here is a small rundown:[hr][/hr]
The market of EMS Simulation and Serious Gaming is oversaturated with mid-quality, point to point driving gameplay. These games and simulators lead to poor immersion quality and often feel like a "Point-A to Point-B" system. Proper representation of the EMS Field in the form of simulation and serious gaming is inaccessible for the home user, whether for leisure or educational training. The "Paramedics!" EMS Simulator bridges the gap from commercial simulation to an obtainable solution for anyone, in the form of realistic and entertaining simulation fidelity. Our product is an in-depth simulation, using open-source software to simulate body systems down to the cellular level accurately. This includes interactions with medications and procedures. Experience the thrill and intensity of being an EMS Clinician.

The focus of “Paramedics!” is not to be an open-world driving simulation anymore. We aim to deliver a high-end, high-fidelity simulation product. We strive to develop an accurate experience which focuses on all nuisances of Emergency Medical Services and Emergency Medicine as a whole. We drive ourselves to develop intuitive player controls and mechanics. With that being said, we are a very small, independent studio team. This gives us the flexibility and ability to develop our product the way we see fit, and to build lasting relationships with our player base. However, this also means that development and such takes time. Though you may not hear from us daily, we are working every day to deliver the best experience possible. Lastly, there are several big features being added to the simulator. Experience Points give you the ability to buy and earn qualifications, progress in tiers, unlock additional callouts, and upgrade equipment. Our base map is modelled after the U.S. and its complex EMS system, drawing inspiration from areas and departments around the country. Lastly, we will add the addition of new maps into the simulator, each map will represent a different country, and as such, a different EMS system.


[hr][/hr]
We still stay mod focused, but the game loop changes to be more structured instead of drive from a to b and deliver patients, yes you will not be able to drive ambulances, but with this adjustment we can focus more on the patient system and scene creation system and in game editor for you to create own scenarios and more.


And on this note, check out the upcoming playable character identities you can choose from (female variant in the works).[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44684661/a22ebb5951e51c8d030b3a925073d3875024ca45.png"]

notes.title: Brief Update on the Next Build Release (v0.0.0.3 Phase0)
notes.content:
Hey! There will be a slight delay in rolling out the next update, and We want to explain why.

Right now, all human body calculations and patient stabilization happen entirely on the game thread. This causes severe lag when spawning patients, something that’s completely unacceptable by our standards (and probably yours too).

In the meantime, here’s a quick video showing what has gone wrong we hope you enjoy this and get a good laugh out of it while you wait!
[previewyoutube=rDR4hRu5Os4;full][/previewyoutube]

We are reworking this system to multi-thread these calculations, ensuring a smooth and responsive gameplay experience. This takes time to get right, but it will massively improve performance, especially in busy scenarios.
We thank you for your patience and support! We will keep you updated as we make progress.

notes.title: v0.0.0.2 Iter1 Charlie
notes.content:
What's New:

Ability to Ask the Patient to Sit/Lay Down or Stand Up:
Introduced a dynamic interaction feature allowing players to instruct patients to sit, lay down, or stand up based on the in-game situation.

Ability to Remove Patient from Stretcher:
Implemented functionality for players to remove patients from stretchers, providing more options for medical interventions and transport.

Ability to Ask the Patient to Show Hands:
Added a new interaction prompt enabling players to instruct patients to show their hands, enhancing realism and potential threat assessment in emergency scenarios.


Bug Fixes and Improvements:
Fixed Camera Movement Speed:
Adjusted camera movement speed for a more intuitive and responsive player experience.

Real Sun Location and Day of Month Based:
Implemented a realistic sun location system based on the day of the month, enhancing in-game lighting dynamics.

Fixed Ambulance Turning Ability:
Resolved issues with ambulance turning ability for smoother navigation during emergency missions.

Remapped and Redesigned Test Map:
Overhauled the test map with remapped areas and a redesigned layout for improved gameplay testing.

Enabled interactions with stretchers and patients, contributing to a more comprehensive medical gameplay experience.

Face Expressions:

Development Highlights:
Progress Update: I've been hard at work refining Paramedics to deliver an immersive and unforgettable experience. Your support has been my driving force, and I've grateful for every wishlist addition.

Teaser:
0.0.0.2 comes with new UI major bug fixing and new player model and clothes!

What's Coming:
Even though the game is still in development, I can't wait to introduce you to some exciting features on the horizon:
Dispatch system and patient overhaul: Get ready to start getting calls and drive on scene! 

Paramedics! community feedback has been invaluable. Make sure to join the community! https://discord.gg/skbM5EZuW4


Spread the Word:
Help me spread the word about Paramedics! Share the Steam page with your friends, family, and fellow gamers who might be interested in joining our community.

Thank you for being a crucial part of the Paramedics journey. I can't wait to share more updates as I continue to bring the game to life!

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2263530/Paramedics/

Warm regards,
Daniel.
